name: Арены этажей биомов 1–4 (ADR-0048, слова автора 02.10.2026: «новая арена на этом же биоме аля условны этаж»): по три новых участка на биом к нынешней арене — четыре арены на биом, этаж выбирает свою по номеру (BS_ART.arenas, design/ui/screens/battle-scene.js). Раскладка и стиль — как у нынешних арен (jobs/batch-01.json, biome-02-forest.json, biome-03-library.json, biome-04-stonehaim.json): строго сверху, четверти карт — ровный пол, детали — в средней половине у верхнего и нижнего края, середина спокойная. Образец каждой арены — нынешняя арена её биома: то же место, другой участок; объекты и их места — свои. Выгрузка — ui-art.json, arena-bN-K.jpg 1688 × 716
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Light tells the story: a few strong sources that glow from within throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and tiny glowing grains float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime, no cartoon. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached reference image (approved game art).
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no glyphs, no runes, no real-world scripts, no carvings that look like writing or numerals, no occult symbols, no heraldry, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture. Tablets, cylinders, cords, crates and walls carry no writing and no signs: only fine worn grooves and texture. No characters, no people, no animals, no gore, no blood, no wounds, no bones, no skulls, no horror grotesque. No purple, no violet, no magenta light.

arenas.frame: Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: wide horizontal battle background for a landscape phone screen, 21:9. Strict top-down orthographic view, the camera looks straight down at the floor like a tabletop RPG battle map: no horizon, no perspective, no side views, no ceiling, no sky. The attached image is another stretch of this very place, already in the game: the new picture must read as the same place — keep its straight-down camera, its scale, the layout of its zones, its darkness, its palette, the material of its floor, its light and its painting style. Do NOT copy its objects or where they lie: this stretch has its own details, described below. The game puts its cards along the left and right sides: five hero cards in the left quarter and five enemy cards in the right quarter, from the top edge to the bottom edge. So the left quarter (0-25% of the width) and the right quarter (75-100% of the width) must be open, flat, evenly lit floor over their whole height: only the floor itself, dust and fine glowing cracks — no objects there. The zones are invisible: no lines, no seams, no panels and no change of color or texture where the quarters meet the central half — the floor is one continuous surface. This stretch is one floor of a long way down: the squad comes in from the left and goes on to the right, so the floor continues beyond the left and right edges of the picture — no side walls, nothing closes the sides. The surroundings — walls, bookcases or the edge of the forest — appear only as a thin strip along the very top and bottom edges, no more than 7% of the height. All details are placed only in the central half (25-75% of the width), close to the top and bottom edges; the middle of the central half stays calm and open, because the game shows banners there.

jobs.subject: Subject: another stretch of the Workshop of Forms, the first hall under the city of Endalor, where a god once sculpted living beings from clay and abandoned the work halfway, seen straight from above: the kneading floor, where the clay for the whole Workshop was prepared. Light: it is cold and dark, the floor lies in deep shadow; white-green crystals glowing from within grow in the cracks and throw their cold light upward; the only warm color is the ochre clay of the unfinished works. Floor: the same large worn grey stone slabs with cracks, drifts and still ripples of pale sand. Along the very top and bottom edges runs a thin strip of the dark foot of stone walls, no more than 7% of the height. In the central half only: near the top edge, two large round stone troughs full of smooth wet ochre clay, side by side, a heavy wooden paddle lying across one of them, deep handprints and finger marks pressed into the clay; a few lumps of clay and a clay-stained cloth on the floor beside them. Near the bottom edge, a long low stone bench with a row of rough clay blanks laid out on it — plain rounded lumps shaped like loaves, none of them a figure; beside it a wooden bucket of grey water and a wooden mallet; one thin stream of sand falls from the unseen vault into a small round pile. The middle of the central half is plain open floor. No cards, no grid.

jobs.subject: Subject: another stretch of the Underground Forest, the finished creation of the god Vial, seen straight from above: the edge of the pack's lair. Light: it is dark, the ground lies in deep shadow and the light comes only from below — from glowing veins and cracks in the earth, glowing fallen leaves and glowing fungi, cold white-green light; glowing spores drift above the ground. Ground: one continuous surface of dark soft earth covered with short pale grey-green moss and a litter of fallen pale leaves, some of them still glowing faintly white-green; fine cracks in the earth glow from within with cold white-green light. Along the very top and bottom edges runs a thin strip of dark roots and pale leaves, no more than 7% of the height; no ferns, no big leaves and no roots in the left and right quarters. In the central half only: near the top edge, the huge pale roots of a giant tree come in from the top edge and form a wide hollow lined with pale moss and dry leaves — a resting place of the pack, empty now; tufts of pale fur caught on the roots and long deep claw marks in the pale bark. Near the bottom edge, a small spring of glowing white-green water rises between pale stones, runs a short way along the bottom edge and goes back into it; beside it a few pale stones overgrown with moss and small clusters of glowing mushrooms. The middle of the central half is plain open floor. No cards, no grid.

jobs.subject: Subject: another stretch of the Library of Ularion, the stone library of the god of knowledge, seen straight from above: a reading place between the bookcases. Light: it is dark, the floor lies in deep shadow and the light comes only from below — from amber-glowing cracks in the floor and the amber sand of hourglasses, warm amber light; the only cold notes are the grey-blue shadows. Floor: large, precisely fitted slabs of dark grey basalt, worn smooth, fine dust and a few chips of stone on them; thin cracks glow from within with warm amber light. Along the very top and bottom edges, the tops of long stone bookcases, seen straight from above, form a thin strip no more than 7% of the height, stacked with plain stone tablets and stone cylinders lying on their sides; the bookcases run on through the left and right edges of the picture. In the central half only: near the top edge, a heavy stone reading stand with one large plain stone tablet lying on it, two bronze hourglasses with glowing amber sand at its corners, and a long cord with many small knots coiled on the floor beside it. Near the bottom edge, a low stone rack with plain stone cylinders standing upright in two short rows, amber light glowing between them; two cylinders lie on the floor beside the rack. The middle of the central half is plain open floor. No cards, no grid.

jobs.subject: Subject: another stretch of Artificial Stoneheim, the full-size living sketch of a dwarven city made by the god Ularion, seen straight from above: the mine yard. Light: it is dark, the pavement lies in deep shadow, darkened by soot, and the light comes only from below — from glowing coals, molten metal and amber-glowing cracks, warm amber and molten orange light; the only cold notes are blue-grey smoke and shadows. Pavement: big, precisely fitted square blocks of warm sandstone-colored stone, worn smooth and darkened by soot, soot in the seams, a few iron rivets and flakes of ash on them; thin cracks glow from within with warm amber light. Along the very top and bottom edges runs a thin dark strip of the foot of stone walls and iron railings, no more than 7% of the height, running on through the left and right edges of the picture. In the central half only: near the top edge, an iron mine cart on short iron feet loaded with lumps of glowing amber ore, standing on a short piece of rail that begins and ends inside the central half; beside it two pickaxes and a leather helmet lying on the pavement. Near the bottom edge, the square mouth of a lifting shaft in a heavy iron frame, a thick chain hanging down into it from a winch drum, amber light rising from deep below; a few lumps of amber ore beside it. The middle of the central half is plain open floor. No cards, no grid.
